$comment: Non-frontmatter dependency edges for deploy/init.mjs. The PRIMARY dependency source is agent frontmatter permissions rules (action:"skill" allows = requiresSkills, action:"subagent" allows = delegatesTo). This map covers only the skill->MCP edge that frontmatter cannot express: when a skill is installed, the listed MCP server(s) should also be enabled. Values MUST match mcp.servers.<key> in opencode_app/opencode.json.
